newsitem.title: FRANCE: French farmers protest at cheap Spanish fruit.
newsitem.headline: French farmers protest at cheap Spanish fruit.

text.p: French fruit farmers protesting against cheap imports stopped a Spanish truck and dumped its cargo of peaches near Marseille early on Wednesday.
The farmers played cat-and-mouse with police for several hours around the Mediterranean port, burning tyres and dumping fruit outside the local office of the European Union.

Farmers destroyed a cargo of Spanish melons near Toulouse in southwest France on Tuesday and dumped cases of fruit outside the offices of Prime Minister Lionel Jospin in his southwestern constituency of Cintegabelle.
Lower-priced imports of fruit and vegetables from countries like Spain and Portugal have hurt French farmers, who have been forced to lower their prices to remain competitive.
